capabilities: Browse agents in a sidebar panel with triggers and model info
Run agents directly or against the currently open note
Stream live executions with tool calls and AI responses
Review execution history with status filters
Start and stop the local agentmd backend from the status bar or commands
extras: Desktop-only (mobile unsupported) because it needs Node.js APIs for the Unix domain socket; not yet in the Obsidian community plugin list, so it must be installed manually from GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view, run, or observe AI agents defined as Markdown files in a local agentmd runtime.

relations.evidence: This plugin turns Obsidian into a visual front end for a local agentmd backend

summary: Sidebar panel that browses, runs, and monitors markdown-defined AI agents through a local agentmd backend via a Unix domain socket.
